concept.flow.input.name: Input
concept.flow.input.definition: The entry point where external data enters the execution context.
concept.flow.input.hint: Always starts as an active power source in the program flow.
concept.flow.parse.name: Parse
concept.flow.parse.definition: Converts raw input data into structured syntax trees or internal models.
concept.flow.parse.hint: Passes clean data forward down the execution stream.
concept.flow.validate.name: Validate
concept.flow.validate.definition: Verifies that incoming parameters satisfy contract schemas and business rules.
concept.flow.validate.hint: Often branches execution into success and error pathways.
concept.flow.loop.name: Loop
concept.flow.loop.definition: Repeats a block of instructions while a terminating condition is evaluated.
concept.flow.loop.hint: Cycles execution flow through multiple connected iterations.
concept.flow.function_call.name: Function Call
concept.flow.function_call.definition: Invokes reusable modular logic with scoped parameters and return addresses.
concept.flow.function_call.hint: Transfers execution control before resuming the main thread.
concept.flow.output.name: Output
concept.flow.output.definition: Emits transformed results to the terminal, caller, or downstream client.
concept.flow.output.hint: A required target node that must be powered to complete the program.
concept.flow.database.name: Database
concept.flow.database.definition: Persists state, records queries, and commits transactional changes to storage.
concept.flow.database.hint: Requires an uninterrupted pipeline to commit data safely.
concept.flow.error_handler.name: Error Handler
concept.flow.error_handler.definition: Catches exceptions, rolls back transactions, and restores stable state.
concept.flow.error_handler.hint: Safety target node designated to intercept failing execution paths.
